title.zh: MIM制造：夹层简单，界面不简单
title.en: MIM fabrication: a simple sandwich with complex interfaces

subtitle.zh: 极板、介质与图形化共同决定性能
subtitle.en: Plates, dielectric and patterning jointly determine performance

body.zh: MIM看似是三层结构，真正难点在介质完整性、界面粗糙度与边缘电场
body.en: MIM appears to have three layers; dielectric integrity, interface roughness and edge electric fields are the real challenges

body.zh: ② 表面清洁与界面预处理
已有金属线或专用下电极
body.en: Existing metal line or dedicated bottom electrode

body.zh: 去除颗粒与残留，保留电极表面
body.en: Remove particles and residue while preserving the electrode surface
Deposition method depends on the material

body.zh: 光刻/显影 → 选择性刻蚀 → 去胶清洁
body.en: Lithography/develop → selective etch → resist strip and clean

body.zh: Via分别接到上、下电极后再路由
body.en: Connect vias separately to the top and bottom electrodes before routing
causing local high fields and leakage
Insufficient sidewall coverage or sharp corners

body.zh: 密度 × 电场 × 寿命
介质更薄可提高密度，但漏电、
body.en: A thinner dielectric increases density, but leakage,
local field and TDDB stress rise

body.zh: 风险与缺陷（对性能与可靠性的影响）
body.en: Risks and defects (effects on performance and reliability)

body.zh: 量测反馈：膜厚图/缺陷检测/结构截面/C-V/I-V
body.en: Measurement feedback: thickness map / defect inspection / cross-section / C–V / I–V

body.zh: 降低短路/开路导致的失效
控制电容离散与寄生耦合，
body.en: Control capacitance variation and parasitic coupling

body.zh: 提升电路一致性与速度
body.en: to improve circuit consistency and speed
Reduce leakage and local electric fields

body.zh: 提升寿命与长期可靠性
body.en: to improve lifetime and long-term reliability

body.zh: 边界：电极、介质、沉积方式与图形化顺序随工艺平台变化，本图是通用学习框架。
body.en: Scope: electrode and dielectric materials, deposition methods and patterning sequence vary by process platform; this is a general learning framework.
